address: Steinacher Straße 9, Haslach im Kinzigtal, 77716, Germany
bio: Inga and Ralf Müller have made a name for themselves with this friendly restaurant. This is due in no small part to the international and regional cuisine, which is made with very good, often local ingredients. The service is attentive and charming. In summer, you can dine on simpler fare in the charming courtyard with its vine arbour. There are chic, modern guestrooms and apartments for overnight stays....
